_meta.convention: SIDE number = points the listed side is favoured by, positive = favoured, negative = underdog. TOTAL number = the game total, identical on both sides. MONEYLINE has no number, only a price. Prices are American. move = close_number - open_number.
_meta.why_blank: An opening number is printed in only one file (initial_lines.csv: 2021, Westgate, spread and total). Every opening moneyline cell is blank because no source in this repository prints one. No file carries a capture timestamp, so both captured_at fields are blank.

movement.note: Computed only over SIDE rows that carry both an opening and a closing number.
